h: Eniola Badmus and Davido at Zlatan Ibile's wedding: a reunion that has fans talking
p: Nollywood actress Eniola Badmus and Afrobeats star Davido have caught the attention of social media users after both appeared at Zlatan Ibile's lavish wedding celebration. The two were once known as close friends, with Eniola openly cheering the singer on through different stages of his career. Their relationship was reported to have cooled after the death of Davido's son, Ifeanyi, in 2022, when the actress faced heavy criticism online over posts about the tragedy. Neither of them has said whether their differences have been settled, so attending the same wedding may not mean the friendship is back.
more: Friendships in the entertainment industry can cool through misunderstandings or public pressure, and sometimes recover quietly away from the cameras.
Zlatan's wedding brought together some of the biggest names in Nigerian entertainment, and fans are following every moment.
Would you like to see Davido and Eniola Badmus rebuild their old friendship, or are some friendships better left in the past?
